name: Financially motivated cybercriminals
description: Phishing crews and initial-access brokers who sell or ransom stolen PII and network access

name: Opportunistic internet scanners
description: Automated campaigns that scan for known vulnerabilities in internet-facing web applications

name: Malicious or curious insider
description: An HR specialist or administrator who misuses legitimate access to view or take employee records

name: Former workforce member
description: A departed employee or contractor whose portal or service account was not disabled

name: Compromised third party
description: An attacker who breaches the payroll provider or benefits carrier and reaches Acme data through the interconnection

name: Privileged user error
description: A system administrator or HR administrator who makes a configuration or role-assignment mistake

name: Certificate and key lifecycle failure
description: Expired or mismanaged certificates and keys that break trusted connections

name: Cloud provider service outage
description: Regional outage of compute, storage, or managed database services in the IaaS tenant

name: Natural disaster at provider site
description: Fire, flood, or severe weather that destroys a provider availability zone
